WHEREAS, the Colorado Department of Transportation approved Ordinance No.
13 on July 12, 2018, subject to its being modified by the deletion of one provision; and
WHEREAS, the Sheriff's Office recommends raising some of the fines
established in Ordinance No. 13;
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE BOARD OF COUNTY
COMMISSIONERS OF THE COUNTY OF CLEAR CREEK, COLORADO AS
FOLLOWS:
Amendment 1. Ordinance No. 13, Part I, Section 3(H) 1701 (4)(a) is deleted in its
entirety and replaced with the following:
(4)(a) Fine Schedule Adopted by Reference.
Every person who is
convicted of, who admits liability for, acknowledges guilt, or against whom a judgment is
entered for a violation of any provision of this Ordinance to which the penalty assessment
procedure adopted herein shall be fined in accordance with the penalty schedule set forth in
C.R.S. § 42-4-1701(4)(a)(I)(A) through 42-4-1701(4)(a)(I)(P), attached hereto as Exhibit
A.
Amendment 2. Exhibit A attached to Ordinance No. 13 is deleted in its entirety
and replaced by Exhibit A, attached hereto.
Amendment 3. Ordinance No. 13 is amended by deleting Part I, Section 3(H)
1701(4)(b) in its entirety.
Amendment 4. Ordinance No. 13, Part IV, Section 6 is deleted in its entirety and
replaced with the following:
Section 6. EFFECTIVE DATE AND REPEAL. Ordinance No. 13 is
effective 30 days after final publication, by title only, of the adoption of Ordinance
No. 13 and of this Amendment by the Board of County Commissioners and shall
apply to traffic offenses occurring or committed on or after that date. When
Ordinance No. 13 takes effect, Ordinance No. 9, and all ordinances or resolutions
or parts of ordinances or resolutions inconsistent with the provisions of this
ordinance are hereby repealed and replaced by this Ordinance No. 13, as amended,
which shall be known as and referred to as the "Clear Creek County Traffic Code".
This Ordinance does not repeal any other Clear Creek County provisions or
enactments allowing or regulating load and weight permits, road closures, or the
use of off-road vehicles, all-terrain vehicles, and snowmobiles on county roads.
